The cloud car was not a good choice for this.|Iden Versio and Del Meeko|}} [[File:Storm_IV_Cloud_Car_EotECR.png|thumb|left|180px|Cloud cars could be modified for use in multiple environments.]] The Storm IV Twin-Pod was an [[Atmosphere|atmospheric]] [[repulsorcraft]] manufactured by [[Bespin Motors]] and designed for patrol and policing purposes. A model of [[cloud car]], the Storm IV consisted of twin "pods" connected by a [[repulsorlift]] engine, and was powered by an [[ion engine]]. The vehicle's [[pilot]] controlled the craft from the port-side pod, while the [[gunner]] housed within the starboard pod sat at the controls of a pair of light [[blaster cannon]]s. ==History== {{Quote|Permission granted to land on Platform 327.|Cloud car pilot, to Han Solo and the ''Millennium Falcon''|{{Film|V}}}} Storm IV Twin-Pods were utilized to keep the peace in the skies of [[Cloud City]], and became a familiar sight as they patrolled and policed the airspace around the [[planet]] [[Bespin]]. Recognized by their distinctive bright orange or [[brick]]-colored hulls, these [[cloud car]]s were deployed to intercept [[starship]]s bound for the floating [[city]]. The vessel's [[pilot]] and [[gunner]] worked in tandem to question approaching [[captain]]s, and to take defensive measures if necessary. When the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' arrived seeking refuge in the city following the [[Battle of Hoth]], the [[Corellian]] [[freighter]] was met by two patrolling cloud cars; one of which fired warning shots at the craft before its captain, [[Han Solo]], was given landing clearance from his old friend, [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]]. The cloud cars escorted the ''Falcon'' along the approach route to Cloud City,{{Databank|cloud-city-history-gallery|Cloud City History Gallery}} and allowed the vessel to land at [[Platform 327]]. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' *''[[Star Wars Battlefront]]'' {{DLC}} *[[Darth Vader (2015) 9|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 9]] *[[Age of Rebellion -
